notes.title: Our First ever devlog!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="odVg2kbfnsM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello one and all, it's time for our first devlog!  [/p][p]As scuffed as it may be, we're excited to find the best ratio between keeping you informed and not taking too much time away from development to record 10-minute videos. [/p][p]Let us know what you think![dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/odVg2kbfnsM"][/dynamiclink][/p]
